Hana L: quick flag - backup with Vault sealed blobs found in partner bucket: s3://partner-archive/redwood/vault-wrapped-backup-2026-03-22.tar.gz
Devon R: ugh. object metadata & which KMS key used?
Hana L: uploader=partner-export-sa@partner-prod, kms_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap-hsm, crc32: e3f6b2
incident-bot: ALERT: sealed-blob-external-upload detected for partner-export-sa (rule: sealed-blob-monitor)
Seth M: containment plan: 1) remove decrypt binding for partner-export-sa 2) copy object to sec-quarantine 3) snapshot KMS IAM & Vault audit 4) start Vault token accessor sweep 5) create incident ticket. I can run revoke + quarantine now.
Hana L: running commands:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partner-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=partners > /tmp/partner-policy-before.json
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding partner-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=partners --member="serviceAccount:partner-export-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
aws s3 cp s3://partner-archive/redwood/vault-wrapped-backup-2026-03-22.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/partner-wrapped-2026-03-22.tar.gz
```
Partner-Infra: partner paused their export job; they think it was a staging cron leak.
Seth M: copied and IAM snapshot saved to gs://ops/audit/partner-policy-before-3609990001.json. starting token sweep for accessors tied to partner activity.
Devon R: create new key version and plan a canary rewrap for 25 objects before full rewrap. add CI gate in onboarding to block direct cryptoKeyDecrypter grants.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-120 (severity: medium) assigned to Hana L, Seth M
Hana L: containment done. moving tracking to INC-2026-120 and scheduling postmortem. closing thread to reduce noise. :white_check_mark:
